description: Estimate front brake bias from piston area, rotor size, and pad friction. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This estimates mechanical bias. Tire grip, weight transfer, ABS, and balance bars still matter.

frontPiston.description: Front total piston area (in2 in imperial; cm2 in metric)

frontRotor.description: Front effective radius (in in imperial; mm in metric)

rearPiston.description: Rear total piston area (in2 in imperial; cm2 in metric)

rearRotor.description: Rear effective radius (in in imperial; mm in metric)

unitSystem.description: Units for all inputs and results, as specified on each field.

name: calculate_brake_bias

outputSchema.description: Public calculator result with explicit units, website-equivalent results, or actionable invalid_input message.

status.description: Result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.

title: Brake Bias Calculator
